author.organization: China Satellite Network Group Co., Ltd.

abstract.t:
BGP Link-State Shortest Path First (BGP-LS-SPF) routing, defined in RFC 9815, uses BGP to distribute link-state information and the SPF algorithm to compute routes. In large-scale networks with frequent topology changes, distributing detailed link-state information across the entire network may introduce significant control-plane overhead and frequent route recomputation.
This document proposes an area-scoped routing mechanism for BGP-LS- SPF. The mechanism divides a network into multiple routing areas, limits the distribution of detailed topology information, and maintains inter-area reachability through boundary routers. It aims to improve routing scalability and stability while supporting distributed route computation.
